proof.text: The closed-immersion ideal acts trivially on scalar Ext, by the general ideal-action theorem.

The pullback adjunction unit is epi and its kernel is the image of ideal multiplication. Since this multiplication is zero, its image inclusion is zero by cancellation of factorThruImage. The kernel universal property proves that the unit is mono, hence an isomorphism in the abelian category.
Apply the conormal determinant comparison on Z, push its isomorphism forward, and compose it with the pullback-unit isomorphism. This gives exactly the unchanged scalar Ext statement on Y.

title: Koszul-regular immersion Ext sheaf nonnegative-degree comparison (0 ≤ q)
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes, locally generated near every point of $Z$ by a finite Koszul-regular sequence. Use the scheme, ideal, module pullback, derived category and internal Hom of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence], [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-pc-derived-category], [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. Let $C=i^*\mathcal I$, $N=\mathcal Hom(C,\mathcal O_Z)$ and let $r:Z\to\mathbb N$ be locally constant and equal to the stalk finrank of $C$, using [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. For every integer $q \geq 0$, $H^q(R\mathcal Hom_Y(i_*\mathcal O_Z,\mathcal O_Y))\cong i_*T^q$, where $T^q$ is the degree-$q$ term of [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex] applied to $N,r$: it is the direct image of $\bigwedge^q(N|_{\{r=q\}})$ from the clopen rank-$q$ stratum for $q\geq0$. This asserts only sheaf isomorphisms, not an isomorphism of derived objects.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulRegularImmersion_extSheaf_nonnegative
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (hregular : ∀ z : Z, ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, i z ∈ U.1 ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1)),
        Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U ∧
          RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f)
    (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ z : Z, r z = Module.finrank (Z.presheaf.stalk z)
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace z).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)))
    {q : ℤ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) q).obj
        ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj
          (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))),
            (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf))) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj
        (Scheme.Modules.locallyRankedExteriorTerm
          (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := Z.sheaf)
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)
            (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)) r q))
